article: Windows shortcuts and practical tips for productivity
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations; compared section coverage, keyboard shortcuts, Windows commands, interface labels, local images, external and internal links, and publication metadata against current Microsoft documentation. There are no mathematical formulas.
findings: Removed duplicate future publication dates, retained the actual 2022-09-18 publication date, and set lastmod to 2026-11-25 in all editions.
Clarified Print Screen behavior, the saved screenshot location, administrator launch shortcut, taskbar switching, and Windows 11 window snapping against Microsoft keyboard and Snipping Tool guidance.
Removed the obsolete Internet Explorer COM launch command; explained that standalone IE support ended and directed legacy-site users to IE mode in Edge.
Marked WordPad as unavailable in Windows 11 version 24H2 and later, and clarified older-version use and current alternatives.
Replaced the ambiguous SetSuspendState rundll32 command with shutdown /h for hibernation; corrected Alt+Space window moving and added data-loss cautions for forced termination.
Removed unrelated internal cross-links that had appeared only in translations and updated every edition with current Microsoft references.

terminology.note: Checked taskbar pinning, window snapping, clipboard, screen snipping, hibernation, administrator launch, Internet Explorer mode, and WordPad terminology.
